args.sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        b.beneregistry,
        b.benedistref,
        CASE 
            WHEN b.commengagelvl = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN b.commengagelvl = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN b.commengagelvl = 'High' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END as commengage_numeric,
        b.vulnerabilityreview,
        b.localcapacitygrowth,
        b.benefeedbackscore,
        b.distequityidx,
        c.stakeholdersatisf
    FROM beneficiariesandassessments b
    JOIN coordinationandevaluation c ON b.beneopsref = c.coordopsref
),
with_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        beneregistry,
        benedistref,
        commengage_numeric,
        vulnerabilityreview,
        localcapacitygrowth,
        benefeedbackscore,
        distequityidx,
        stakeholdersatisf,
        benefeedbackscore * 10 + (commengage_numeric * 20) + distequityidx * 50 as BSI,
        (benefeedbackscore * 10 + (commengage_numeric * 20) + distequityidx * 50) / 100.0 * commengage_numeric * ((stakeholdersatisf + 1) / 5.0) as CEE
    FROM base
)
SELECT 
    beneregistry,
    benedistref,
    ROUND(CAST(CEE AS numeric), 4) as CEE_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN localcapacitygrowth = 'Active' AND commengage_numeric = 3 AND BSI > 70 THEN 'Community Resilience Builder'
        WHEN CEE > 2.5 AND vulnerabilityreview = 'Complete' AND NOT (localcapacitygrowth = 'Active' AND commengage_numeric = 3 AND BSI > 70) THEN 'Community Resilience Opportunity'
        ELSE 'Standard Operation'
    END as classification
FROM with_scores
LIMIT 10;
